title: #TeaLizard Takes Over Twitter

image.attribution: Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff from Washington D.C, United States / Wikimedia Commons / Public Domain.

main_content:
LeBron James was emotional Sunday night after the National Basketball Association championship.

Photographs of the basketball star crying after the win spread on social media. To some people, the photos looked a lot like the popular internet meme #CryingJordan.

A meme is a funny image or a video that is copied – with small changes – and spread on social media.

On Tuesday, the ABC television show Good Morning America asked on Twitter about a possible new #CryingLeBron meme.

The Tweet included a picture of Kermit the Frog drinking tea.

Kermit the Frog is part of the popular Internet meme known as “None of My Business.”

Kermit is one of the Muppets, a group of characters created by puppeteer Jim Henson.

Good Morning America’s tweet read: “Does #CryingLeBron join other meme greats like #tealizard, [and] #CryingJordan?”

Twitter users quickly reacted, criticizing the TV show for calling Kermit the Frog a lizard. Kermit is, of course, a frog puppet. Not a lizard puppet.

People on social media mocked Good Morning America for mistaking the world-famous frog for a lizard.

questions.question: Why did LeBron James cry?
options: He was overwhelmed with joy after winning the championship
He was comforted by his teammates
He was criticized by fans after the game
questions.answer: He was overwhelmed with joy after winning the championship

questions.question: What is an Internet meme?
options: A funny image or video that is copied and spread on social media
A sports term used in basketball
questions.answer: A funny image or video that is copied and spread on social media

questions.question: Why did people criticize the ABC television show Good Morning America?
options: For incorrectly labeling Kermit the Frog as a lizard
For ignoring the LeBron James emotional moment
questions.answer: For incorrectly labeling Kermit the Frog as a lizard
